- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:983 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fail-open `|| : > "$LOG_FILE"` on API failure creates an empty log file, causing all subsequent greps to report zero matches and silently force the full ELAPSED wait timeout instead of surfacing the transient API failure.
  WHY: On GitHub API blips (rate-limit, network flake), the e2e poller always burns the full ~10+ min budget per smoke run without diagnostic, inflating release gate wall time; no early classification even when reviewers/editor already succeeded.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1031-1032 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `.*` anchors in grep -E patterns risk over-matching lines containing the substring outside reviewer context.
  WHY: Over/under-counting reviewers could cause premature "pass" early-exit or infinite wait, blocking or misclassifying the release gate.
